titleStmt.title: History of the Zhou Dynasty · Shang 商

div.interp: 𢀛方: the graph is 工 over 口 (𢀛), which the site's font lacks, so it is drawn. The state is read Qiongfang; some transcribe it 工方.
呼妇好伐土方: an oracle-bone formula, 呼 "call on" being the verb by which the king commands a subordinate to act; the inscription is the divination charge, not a narrative.
方: the graph, 中 with a doubled vertical stroke, has no Unicode code point and is drawn; read mou.
《周易》: the lines on Gaozong's campaign against the Guifang, in the hexagrams Jiji 既济 (third line) and Weiji 未济 (fourth line); Gaozong is Wu Ding.
传世文献: the Documents, "Wuyi" 无逸, gives Gaozong fifty-nine years on the throne; Zu Jia's flight among the people is Ma Rong's reading of the same chapter.
薰鬻戎狄: the Basic Annals of Zhou have the 薰育戎狄 attack Gugong Danfu, who is King Tai; the Mencius writes 獯鬻.
列女传: the Biographies of Exemplary Women, compiled by Liu Xiang of the Western Han.
帝辛: the last king of Shang, the Zhou 纣 of the later texts.
雷暴震死: the Basic Annals of Yin have 武乙猎于河渭之间，暴雷，武乙震死.
牧师: the Bamboo Annals, where Wen Ding is Tai Ding, have under his second year 周人伐燕京之戎，周师大败 and under his fourth 周人伐余无之戎，克之。周王季命为殷牧师.
帝乙处殷，二年，周人伐商: a fragment of the old-text Bamboo Annals preserved in the Taiping Yulan, juan 83.
帝辛: the last king of Shang, the Zhou 纣 of the later texts; the name 纣 is used once below.

小臣艅犀尊: the vessel is in the Asian Art Museum, San Francisco, whose translation is followed for the first clause; the Museum reads 夷方 as Renfang, takes 来征 as the King's return from the campaign, and takes 隹王十祀又五，彡日 as the King's fifteenth sacrificial day in the rong-ritual cycle.
有亡荒阅: Legge's translation; the law of King Wen as the Zuozhuan gives it under Duke Zhao's seventh year, 周文王之法曰：有亡荒阅，所以得天下也. Du Yu reads 荒 as great and 阅 as to search.
西伯: after Legge's title for the chapter 西伯戡黎 of the Documents, "The Chief of the West's Conquest of Li".
黎之蒐: after Legge. The Zuozhuan, Duke Zhao, fourth year, has 商纣为黎之蒐，东夷叛之, in Legge "Chow of the Shang dynasty held the review of Le, and the E of the east revolted from him".
太誓, 牧誓: chapters of the Documents, where 太誓 is written 泰誓; the English titles are Legge's.
